Theme

Latin word

ōrdō

ōrdō, ōrdinis m.

noun, third declension

order or arrangement; a regular order, the way things follow one another; row; a row, a series in order; social class, rank; a class or order of society; order, arrangement

Examples

  • Omnia in ōrdinem redigāmus.

    Let’s put everything in order.composed

    In the entry for order

  • Quis enim hunc hominem dīxerit, quī, cum tam certōs caelī mōtūs, tam ratōs astrōrum ōrdinēs … vīderit, neget in hīs ūllam inesse ratiōnem …?

    For who would call him a man who, seeing such regular movements in the sky and such fixed patterns in the stars, denies that there is any reason in them?Cic. N. D. 2.97
